The negligible system resistance (R< 0.05 W·cm2) demonstrates the ability of the custom- built test equipment to maintain its performance across each timestamp, and apparent fluctuations are likely attributable to the slight changes in sample position between each measurement. Figure 19b shows the optical transmission spectrum of a representative outdoor-aged FS-TCC before and after 1,000 hours of environmental exposure. As shown, a noticeable reduction in transparency between the approximate range of 380 nm to 500 nm is observed for the outdoor aged sample, accompanied by slight discoloration and embrittlement of the polymer matrix (Figure 22c). In comparison, a control sample demonstrated a near-coincident spectrum before and after 1,000 hours of storage in a desiccator. Nonetheless, the outdoor-aged FS-TCCs maintained their initial resistances, evidencing the potential for long-term durability of that property in a semi-arid tropical environment.
